headline: Dave Thorpe invented Earth-616
post:

headline: Showcase #34 debuts size-changing hero before Ant-Man
post:
Comic fans know that Marvel and DC have plenty of familiar rivalries, but one of the most underrated is between Ant-Man and the Atom. According to ComicBook.com, the Atom actually debuted first in 1961's Showcase #34 before Marvel introduced Hank Pym the following year. Both characters emerged during the early 1960s super-hero explosion and became incredibly rare finds for collectors today.

The Atom was created when Ivy University scientist Ray Palmer harnessed energy from a collapsed white dwarf star to invent a shrinking lens. After saving his girlfriend and students from a cave-in, Palmer adopted his super-hero identity and eventually joined the Justice League. Over the decades, the shrinking hero has starred in solo adventures, team-ups, and even live-action adaptations on television.

Only eighteen copies of Showcase #34 exist in a CGC-graded 9.0 or better condition. This makes high-grade copies exceptionally rare and valuable for serious collectors hunting for Silver Age history.

Who is your favorite underrated DC hero? 

#TheAtom #DCComics #ComicBooks
original_title: This Rare DC Comic Introduced a Size-Changing Hero Before Marvel’s Ant-Man, and It’s Worth a Fortune

post:

headline: Wonder Woman assembles the ultimate Wonder Girls team
post:
Diana Prince just made a massive power move in Tom King and Daniel Sampere's comic run. According to Screen Rant, the penultimate issue brings together an incredible supergroup of every hero who has ever carried the title Wonder Girl to fight back against the Sovereign. 

This powerhouse team unites iconic heroes like Donna Troy, Cassie Sandsmark, and Yara Flor alongside Diana's daughter Lizzie Prince, who takes the Trinity name for herself.
